messages:
Ellen: FYI scheduling a focused runtime upgrade tonight 23:00 UTC. Regions: eu-west then us-west. Runtime 1.3.2 -> 1.4.0 plus a tiny model-store schema migration for Dedicated pools. Need a compact statuspage blurb + customer email.

Rohit: Can take statuspage + email. Abort criteria?

Ellen: Canary in eu-west for 10m. Abort if error rate >1% sustained for 5m or p95 latency +300ms. If aborted we pin affected Dedicated tenants to 1.3.2 and notify.

DeployBot: Deploy scheduled by ellen: start=2026-03-21T23:00:00Z, canary=10m, stagger=eu-west->us-west, window=60m. Manual hold enabled.

Bea: Ops preflight summary:
- 22:25 UTC: snapshot model-store
- 22:35 UTC: cache pre-warm (top prefixes)
- 22:45 UTC: stop non-critical batch jobs
- 22:55 UTC: run smoke: ./ops/smoke_inference.sh
If any fail we abort preflight and post incident.

Rohit: Statuspage draft (short):
"Planned maintenance: 21 Mar 2026 23:00 UTC (eu-west, us-west)
We will perform a runtime upgrade of our inference service. Maintenance window up to 60 minutes. Some Dedicated pools may be pinned to previous runtime (v1.3.2) if we detect instability. Possible brief increased latency or transient errors for a small number of customers."

Ellen: Email subject: "Planned maintenance: inference runtime upgrade  21 Mar 23:00 UTC"

Rohit: Email body (concise):
"Hello,
We will upgrade our inference runtime on 21 Mar at 23:00 UTC for eu-west and us-west. The window is up to 60 minutes. You may see elevated latency or transient errors on Dedicated pools. If stability issues occur we will pin affected Dedicated customers to the previous runtime (v1.3.2) to preserve availability.
If you have critical jobs, reply or contact support@redwood.ai to request a carve-out.
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops"

Bea: Add enterprise phone contact line and note that automatic model uploads will not be retried during migration; ops will validate and retry after.

Ellen: Good. Post statuspage and schedule emails at 22:00 and 22:45. When DeployBot starts paste the deploy logs here and update every +5m. I'll watch canary and post live updates.

DeployBot: When started: will post deploy log URL to this thread.
